description: Purchase an empty lot on the current shard's terrain. Pre-checks road-bit validity (CLAUDE.md gotcha 12) and already-owns guard before issuing the city-socket PDU. Updates owned-lots.json on success (I0-7 habitation block initialised to null).

args.name: target_lot_location
args.description: Packed tile coordinate as hex (0x00F9015C) or decimal uint32. MapCoordinates.Pack(x,y) = x<<16|y. Must have road bits: (GetRoad(x,y) & 0xF) != 0.

args.name: name
args.description: Lot name (max 64 chars). Must be unique on the shard.

args.name: start_fresh
args.description: If true, bypass lot-state carry-over (for mayor-mode community lot placement). Defaults false.

args.name: allow_move
args.description: If true, skip the ALREADY_OWNS pre-check. The server will charge a move fee. Use only when explicitly re-purchasing or moving. Defaults false.

common_mistakes: target_lot_location must be the PACKED tile coordinate (x<<16|y), not the DB lot_id. See CLAUDE.md gotcha 11.
The target tile must have road bits — check CLAUDE.md gotcha 12: (GetRoad(x,y) & 0xF) != 0.
If the shard neighborhood has NHOOD_RESERVED (flag & 1), every non-mayor purchase fails. Escalate to an operator.
ALREADY_OWNS is returned if the persona already owns a lot; set allow_move=true only if you intend to pay the move fee.
